findings.evidence: Firebase Admin SDK captures FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST when its Auth request handler is constructed; Admin getUser/createUser support exact UID, email, and password.
findings.condition: Set and validate the loopback Auth emulator host and exact sandbox project before Admin app/Auth initialization. Only auth/user-not-found means absent; all other errors stop.

findings.evidence: The previous provisioning helper generates a random UID through REST sign-up and performs backend account registration; the server Admin abstraction does not expose getUser/createUser.
findings.condition: Use a dedicated local Admin SDK operation bound to the prior provision receipt. Existing user: match email and enabled state with no mutation. Missing user: create once with exact UID/email/password; stop on conflict or uncertain result, without retry.

findings.evidence: Firebase Auth Emulator refresh-token validation checks the embedded project ID then looks up the user by embedded local ID. Exact UID/project restoration supports refresh but cannot establish that the app still has a usable refresh token.
findings.condition: Require ordinary app boot to prove the same account and exact active Q1 session/options/progress before dependent UI; stop on mismatch and verify original Guest state after returning to Guest.

findings.evidence: Backend smoke configuration uses patternly-app-sandbox and Auth 127.0.0.1:19099 while retaining Firestore at 127.0.0.1:18081; dev:admin is a separate project/environment.
findings.condition: Start/reuse Auth only; preserve the existing Firestore process/data; do not use dev:admin, API registration, client sign-in, token revocation, emulator import, or global reset.
